top_issues: Small secondary labels under total balance make reading difficult for vision-impaired users
Color bar distinctions (green vs violet) rely heavily on color perception rather than clear labeling
fixes: Increase font size and contrast for secondary balance breakdowns
Add explicit text badges or icons alongside color-coded balance bars

top_issues: Dense technical routing and balance cards may intimidate non-technical users
Small hexadecimal addresses dominate the recipient area without friendly name resolution
fixes: Collapse advanced route mechanics into an expandable section by default
Emphasize recipient alias over raw hex address strings

top_issues: Modal overlay hides underlying activity context
Truncated proof hash offers limited immediate confirmation without opening an external viewer
fixes: Provide quick-copy feedback tooltips for transaction proof hashes
Increase button size for primary action 'Done' to improve touch accessibility

top_issues: Inbound capacity constraints are subtle and may confuse users if a payment exceeds room
QR code area lacks prominent settlement network identification
fixes: Make capacity warnings more prominent near the QR container
Add explicit network and token icons inside the QR panel

top_issues: Order book and credit extension controls create high visual density and cognitive load
Red warning text at bottom creates anxiety without guiding immediate resolution
fixes: Separate swap execution from credit limit adjustment steps
Clarify capacity requirement steps directly above the action button

top_issues: Cross-chain legs diagram is complex for regular users seeking simple bridging
Floating tooltip obscures underlying collateral settings
fixes: Simplify multi-leg visual timeline with clear status stages
Anchor explanatory tooltips to dedicated info icons rather than hover states

top_issues: Terminology like 'uncovered' and 'credit line to them' requires strong domain knowledge
Action buttons at top lack visual distinction between routine and high-risk operations
fixes: Add contextual explanations for credit and collateral balance metrics
Style the Dispute action with clear secondary safety treatment

top_issues: Dispute dialog text is small, dense, and difficult to parse under high stress
Background content bleed-through impairs dialog legibility
fixes: Increase modal background opacity to 100% to isolate dispute warnings
Use larger bulleted steps with bold risk highlights in the dialog

top_issues: List items have subtle tap targets and small timestamps
Distinction between swaps and basic transfers relies on minor icon variations
fixes: Enlarge list row padding and increase timestamp contrast
Add explicit category tags to list entries

top_issues: Duplicate screen state to activity overview with static detail pane
Technical frame details overshadow commercial transaction summary
fixes: Elevate recipient and status summary above cryptographic frame IDs
Enable direct export of single transaction receipt from detail pane

top_issues: Pixel scale slider and advanced appearance toggles add unnecessary complexity
Sensitive vault operations sit close to superficial appearance settings
fixes: Move vault security actions to a dedicated Security sub-tab
Simplify scaling options to standard preset tiers

top_issues: Grid selection for From/To locations causes spatial confusion
Terminology (Wallet vs Reserve vs Account) requires conceptual training
fixes: Convert From/To selector into a clear linear flow with arrows
Add brief inline tooltips defining Reserve versus Account

top_issues: Tile navigation creates fragmented pathways across related risk functions
Summary text repeats concepts from Home without providing new actions
fixes: Reorganize sub-features into structured list groups
Focus summary card on outstanding counterparty action items

top_issues: Testnet faucet controls blend into production asset displays
Long decimal fractions in credit slider create visual clutter
fixes: Segregate faucet tools into an explicit debug badge or drawer
Round display fractions to standard decimal places

top_issues: Empty pool figures offer little feedback on liquidity depth or interest history
Term and rate inputs resemble basic forms rather than yield calculators
fixes: Add estimated return calculations below interest inputs
Display active pool volume indicators directly beside terms

top_issues: Technical jargon regarding 'lazy entity' and 'board hashes' lacks actionable context
Empty state card on the right feels disconnected and sparse
fixes: Translate board mechanics into plain governance terminology
Collapse unused multi-signer states until initiated

top_issues: High concentration of protocol proofs may overwhelm users looking for basic security status
Key identifiers use raw hashes without easy export verification
fixes: Group cryptographic proof data under an advanced verification disclosure
Add one-click integrity check status indicators

top_issues: Table columns are compressed and require horizontal scanning across multiple numbers
Dense layout challenges readability on smaller desktop viewports
fixes: Provide column toggles to hide less frequently used balances
Increase row height and vertical spacing between table records

top_issues: Quick-command list covers central screen information
Shortcut hints lack contrast against the modal surface
fixes: Increase contrast for keyboard shortcut badges
Allow keyboard navigation through clear focus rings

overall.verdict: The desktop interface provides rich visibility into bilateral credit, cryptographic proofs, and off-chain states. However, dense terminology and technical metrics create unnecessary friction for mainstream users.
priority_fixes: Clarify and simplify credit and collateral terminology across balance views
Separate technical proof details into progressive disclosure drawers
Streamline swap and transfer flows by decoupling capacity configuration
Increase typography scale and contrast for critical financial amounts
Group administrative and security settings into clearer distinct views
